etymology_chain.definition: a written page, leaf, sheet ( transferred ) a piece of writing a ( bronze ) plaque on the pedestal for statues listing the person 's titles, offices and merits ( Medieval Latin ) a legal document ( charter, will )

definitions.text_mt: Wiċċ wieħed minn folja tal-karta f'ktieb jew gazzetta.

usage_examples.mt: Fetaħ il-paġna għaxra tal-ktieb biex jaqra l-kapitlu.
usage_examples.en: He opened page ten of the book to read the chapter.

definitions.text_mt: Sett ta' paġni stampati u magħqudin flimkien bil-qoxra li jkun fihom test jew storja.

usage_examples.mt: Qara ktieb interessanti dwar l-istorja tal-gżejjer Maltin.
usage_examples.en: He read an interesting book about the history of the Maltese islands.

definitions.text_mt: Materjal irqiq u ċatt magħmul minn fibra tal-injam użat għall-kitba, l-istampar u l-ippakkjar.

definitions.text_en: piece of paper, sheet of paper
definitions.text_mt: Fojl jew werqa singula ta' karta.
Karta iebsa jew plastik b'informazzjoni stampata.
Dokumenti u karti uffiċjali.

usage_examples.mt: Kiteb in-noti tiegħu fuq karta bajda b'pinna bajda.
usage_examples.en: He wrote his notes on a white sheet of paper with a black pen.

definitions.text_mt: Oġġett, kwalità jew kunċett li jikkorrispondi għal wheel.
Oġġett, kwalità jew kunċett li jikkorrispondi għal bicycle.

usage_examples.mt: L-użu ta' rota kien prominenti u utli ħafna fil-ħajja.
usage_examples.en: The use of wheel was prominent and very useful in life.

definitions.text_mt: Apparat mekkaniku jew elettriku użat biex jaħdem u jmexxi l-vetturi.

usage_examples.mt: Il-magna tal-karozza bdiet taħdem bla ebda storbju.
usage_examples.en: The car engine started working without any noise.

definitions.text_mt: Kontenitur b'forma kwadra jew rettangolari bil-kopertura użat biex jinżammu l-oġġetti.
Ammont ta' flus miġbura flimkien għal għan jew f'logħba.
Komplo jew pjan fittizju f'dramm jew film.

usage_examples.mt: Ftaħt il-kaxxa tal-injam u sibt ittri antiki fiha.
usage_examples.en: I opened the wooden box and found old letters inside it.

definitions.text_mt: Għamara maħsuba biex wieħed jorqod u jistrieħ fuqha.

usage_examples.mt: It-tifel mar jorqod fis-sodda tiegħu f'ħin uffiċjali.
usage_examples.en: The boy went to sleep in his bed at an official time.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' ċavetta fl-użu u t-tifsira uffiċjali.
Apparat li juri l-ħin u s-sigħat tal-jum.

usage_examples.mt: L-arloġġ tal-ħajt daqq fit-tnax ta' nofsinhar.
usage_examples.en: The wall clock struck twelve noon.

definitions.text_en: bark, shell, rind, crust, book cover
definitions.text_mt: Il-parti ta' barra iebsa u niexfa tal-frotta, tas-siġra jew tal-ktieb.

usage_examples.mt: Neħħew il-qoxra tal-larinġa qabel ma kielha.
usage_examples.en: They removed the orange peel before he ate it.

definitions.text_mt: Għandu x'jaqsam ma' steel (metal).
Tifsira u deskrizzjoni ta' 'għodda': tool.
Tifsira u deskrizzjoni ta' 'għodda': instrument.

usage_examples.mt: Għodda kien f'postu fil-bini u fl-użu ta' kuljum.
usage_examples.en: The għodda was in its proper place in daily use.

definitions.text_mt: Dar jew bini jew art pussess ta' persuna bir-rekords legali.

usage_examples.en: They built a new property in the Rabat area.
